description: A painted close-up, in an oil-painting style, of an older person's hands. A rectangular silver-cased smartwatch sits on the left wrist, and its dark screen shows a glowing green-and-yellow heartbeat trace. A fingertip from the other hand rests near the watch's side button. The background is dark brown with loose brushwork, and a grey-brown sleeve sits at the lower left. I see no visible text, frame, blood or nudity.
